disease_label_per_paper: HCMV mononucleosis-like syndrome with erythema multiforme-like eruptions
presentation_summary: Previously healthy 31-year-old man presented with 4 weeks of non-itching rash and malaise, with high fever to 40 C appearing 2 weeks after rash onset.
He had annular erythematous target lesions and papules on the dorsum, neck, face, and upper limbs including palms and dorsal hands.
He had no lymphadenopathy, mucosal involvement, genital involvement, sore throat, or pharyngeal abnormality.
Admission vitals were temperature 38 C, pulse 96/min, respiratory rate 18/min, blood pressure 110/70 mmHg, and oxygen saturation 98%.

Labs showed WBC 10.27 x10^9/L, lymphocytes 8.17 x10^9/L (79.6%), neutrophils 1.71 x10^9/L, hemoglobin 11 g/dL, platelets 284 x10^9/L, AST 133 U/L, ALT 177 U/L, bilirubin 0.51 mg/dL, creatinine 0.99 mg/dL, and CRP 33.9 mg/L.
CT chest and abdomen showed no pathologic findings except splenomegaly of 15 cm; HCMV IgM/IgG and blood HCMV DNA confirmed acute CMV mono-like illness.

The rash is encoded using a parent rash_activity plus a D-CMV-MONO-specific erythema multiforme-like satellite axis.
